newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Taipan intersects nickel at prospect.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Taipan intersects nickel at prospect.

text.p: Taipan Resources NL said on Friday exploration drilling had intersected lateritic nickel mineralisation at the Siberia mine project northwest of Ora Banda in Western Australia
A total of 41 reverse circulation holes representing 2,005 metres were drilled during December, the company said.
The drilling targeted lateritic nickel accumulations in weathered ultramafic rocks of the Walter Williams formation on its upper contact with the Siberia Komatite, it said.

The Walter Williams formation hosts the Cawse nickel-cobalt deposits to the south east, near Ora Banda, which has a resource of 193 million tonnes, grading 0.7 percent nickel and 0.04 percent cobalt, Taipan said.
Taipan holds 100 percent of the project, with Centaur Mining and Exploration Ltd earning a 75 percent interest.
